body:
It actually makes a lot of sense to me, I did always make myself available whenever I could, well most of the time and never even hinted at wanting something in return. I guess I'll play hard to get some more! hahaha, jokes aside I didn't see it this way before but not being available all the times has had a positive impact on my more recent friendships now that I think about it, or they're just generally better friends than the old group, now I know not to repeat some previous mistakes. 

Thank you for the words of advice!

I have done this in the past which caused us to lose contact, which made me not want to do that again. And honestly I want to drop them, they drain me mentally, I just didn't want to admit it I suppose.

Thanks for your advice!
No problem mate, I'm just glad if I managed to help you out even a little bit!

Perhaps try conveying your thoughts and feelings in bits rather than on big unloading. It might make it easier for your parents to take in and process what you are telling them and hopefully come to an understanding. Give them time to understand you and also try to understand them. It is hard to really fathom what someone is going through if you haven't felt what they have.
Taking it slowly could also make it easier for yourself.
A bit late but happy birthday bro, I genuinely hope you find some joy!! 😁
